    Changelog

    1.5.1

    • Alt+Enter (Option+Enter on macOS) while editing inserts a line break inside the cell without committing; selected text is replaced.

    1.5.0

    • Asset path columns flag paths that can't be found with a warning icon and red text; hovering shows where Tabular Editor looked. Click N missing asset paths in the status bar to go to the next one.
    • Dropping assets from the Project window onto a cell writes their paths in the format the column uses (Resources path or Assets/…), one per row downward.

    1.4.0

    Added

    • Columns of asset paths are recognized automatically and their cells show the Project window icon. Hover for a preview card; Ctrl/Cmd+click or right-click Show in Project pings the asset.
    • Asset path display can be turned off for all files in Preferences, or per file from the window ⋮ menu.

    Fixed

    • Scrolling stuttered in files with many long cells (thousands of characters). Cells now draw only what fits; editing, copy and save still use the full value.

    1.3.0

    Added

    • Ctrl+G go to a row or cell (120, C120, 120:3).
    • Fill handle: drag to continue numbers and text ending in a number, or copy other values. Hold Alt/Option on release to swap continuing and copying.

    Changed

    • The status bar shows the active cell as an address (C12).

    Fixed

    • Input placeholders were not dimmed in the Android Studio theme.

    1.2.0

    Added

    • English/Korean UI switch (window ⋮ menu or Preferences). Follows the OS language at first.

    Fixed

    • Horizontal trackpad swipes, tilt wheels and Shift+wheel did not scroll the table sideways.

    1.1.0

    Added

    • Themes (Unity / Android Studio).
    • Frozen header rows (row number context menu Set Header Rows Up to Selection), stored in .meta and shared with your team.
    • Find and replace: match case, regex, whole word, find in selection, vertical search, replace, replace all and preserve case.
    • Reload files changed outside the editor right away; with unsaved edits, a notice bar asks what to do.
    • Columns fit their content when a file opens; double-click a column border to fit again.
    • The cell edit field grows right and down with its content.
    • File format dialog: choose the encoding (including legacy code pages such as CP949), delimiter, quote, quote mode and line ending, then reopen or apply.
    • Preferences > Tabular Editor: font size, mouse wheel zoom, column auto-fit and the format of new CSV files.
    • Ascending/descending sort from the column menu (numbers and dates recognized, empty cells last).
    • Row and column shortcuts: add (Ctrl+Alt+Arrow), jump to data edge (Ctrl+Arrow), delete (Ctrl+-), duplicate rows (Ctrl+D), move by one (Alt+Arrow) and fill the selection (Ctrl+Enter).
    • Clicking empty space selects the nearest cell.

    Changed

    • Removed the first row as header toggle and the Save and Reload buttons from the toolbar. Column titles are always A, B, C.
    • The search button is now an icon, and the status bar shows the file format.
    • The active cell stays at the cell where the selection started.
    • Large files load in the background.

    1.0.1

    • Lowered the supported version to Unity 6.0. Double-clicking .csv/.tsv files opens them on Unity 6.0 through 6.3 and later.

    1.0.0

    First release of Tabular Editor.

    File handling

    • Added RFC 4180-compatible CSV and TSV parsing and writing, including quoted fields, embedded separators and line breaks, and escaped quotes.
    • Preserved source encoding, BOM, line-ending style, and final-newline state.
    • Added a TSV Scripted Importer and CSV/TSV double-click open handler.
    • Added a confirmation before overwriting a file changed by another tool.

    Editing

    • Added keyboard navigation, range selection, direct typing, F2 editing, and IME-safe text entry.
    • Added save, dirty-state tracking, reload, and close confirmation.
    • Added table-local Undo/Redo, clipboard operations, and cell search.
    • Added row and column append, contextual insert/remove commands, and full row/column deletion.
